one_liner: Team collaboration software providing instant messaging, audio/video calls, and developer platforms with REST APIs and MCP support.
access_notes: Developers can register applications in the Zoho API console for free self-serve credentials.
verdict_reason: Zoho Cliq provides self-serve OAuth credentials, extensive REST APIs, webhooks, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
